resolved_findings.summary: Canonical HNSW Delete() was soft-only (hnsw.go:629); no online compaction is reachable in canonical mode (main.go close(compactDone)); and restart did NOT reclaim because Import re-added tombstoned vectors to the rebuilt graph. RSS and the on-disk snapshot grew ~linearly with cumulative deletes with no online or restart remedy.
resolved_findings.fix: Import() now skips version-2 deleted entries (mirroring Compact()'s continue-on-deleted), so a restart rebuilds a clean graph. The durable store reconciles on Active=Count-Deleted, unchanged by dropping tombstones, so it is a pure reclamation. TestHNSWExportImport rewritten to assert reclaim intent (Deleted==0, Count==Active after import).
resolved_findings.verification: A/B control on identical churn + graceful restart against a 76.6MB tombstoned snapshot: OLD binary reloads in 50s and re-checkpoints byte-identically (76,625,482 -> 76,625,482 B, unreclaimed); FIXED binary reloads in ~8s and shrinks the snapshot 73.4MB -> 24.1MB (-67%) with correctness intact (live searchable, deletes stay gone, re-insert findable).
